title: Person
description: A person (#1005), a humanoid who never fights (owner's worldbuilding rules): their player-facing name and their codex entry. Region legends place them by id (NpcSpot), and dialogs name their speaker by it, so a person's name and entry live once, however many dialogs they speak. One file per person, named after its id; quests and saves name a person by it, so an id is never reused.

id.description: Their name in lower case, spaces made underscores (#909), e.g. teska_na_amvrel; never reused.

codex.description: Their codex entry (#959): what the player reads on their codex page.

entry.description: A short text about them and where their name comes from.

gloss.description: What their name means, hand-written (#959), e.g. "Teska, sworn to the guild".
